profile.text: Nasti Lunorey, director of Rhine Lab's Engineering Section and one of Columbia's foremost authorities in engineering, as well as an expert in applied linguistics. With a reference from Saria, she has entered into a long-term memorandum of cooperation with Rhodes Island and provides support for various projects as a special consultant to the Engineering Department.
